poc_summary: 4-week Hosted API POC: integrated chat widget + doc search. Ingested ~1.2M tokens of product docs. Measured steady-state traffic from beta cohort: 6 avg QPS (mostly chat short), peak observed 38 QPS during feature announcement test. Embedding lookups ~18% of calls. Caching reduced token consumption for repeated queries by ~42%. Team satisfied with accuracy; primary concerns are burst handling and cost at scale.

dedicated_capacity_needs: Recommend initial Dedicated pool: 4 x A10-class GPUs to cover baseline with autoscale to 6 GPUs for peak bursts; 8 worker processes per GPU, persistent KV cache nodes colocated. Expected steady throughput ~20 QPS for gen models with provisioned latency SLO ~<250ms p95 for short chats. If customer prefers lower latency p95 <150ms, bump to 6 GPUs baseline.
pricing_notes: Customer price-sensitivity moderate. Asking for committed discount tiers (12-18 month) and a test-to-prod credit bridge. Wants per-GPU and per-token blended estimate to compare against current hosted spend. Estimated committed ARR ask: $60k–$180k depending on discount and retention of embeddings traffic to a cache tier.
